reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Use the Segment 104 C marker and Element 29's stated Direct Marketing/AVS use. The exact activation condition and off-context omission policy remain open.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: Symbolic field-level design only. Invoice value is synthetic and must not be treated as a real merchant invoice or complete Purchase Card Data Segment.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References SEG104-R-014 format scope; this draft addresses conditional applicability only and does not modify the official baseline.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must define the Direct Marketing/AVS trigger, transaction context, authorized invoice fixture, off-context handling, and readiness before promotion or execution.

requirementReferences.title: Segment 104 Element 29 Direct Marketing Invoice Number is conditionally used in Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Requests.
Direct Marketing Invoice Number is alphanumeric, max 10 characters, when populated.

sourceEvidence.quote: 10 29 Direct Marketing Invoice Number 10 C Identifies the invoice number in a direct marketing transaction.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: Segment 104 field 10 / Element 29 is marked Conditional and identifies an invoice number in a direct marketing transaction.

sourceEvidence.quote: Purpose: Identifies the invoice number in a Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Request.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The element definition names Direct Marketing/AVS requests as its purpose context.

sourceEvidence.quote: Processing Rules: Used in Direct Marketing/Address Verification System Request.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The source states the field is used in DM/AVS requests but does not define the upstream transaction indicator or enumerate every context where omission is permitted.

aiReviewReferences.assessment: All three payloads contain a Segment 104 container declaration but Element 29, Purchase Code, and PC amount fields are declared omitted. The payload metadata does not demonstrate a Direct Marketing/AVS trigger; the field omission cannot be adjudicated against the conditional rule.

testScenarios.intent: In a reviewed-valid Segment 104 request, compare a confirmed Direct Marketing/AVS context with Element 29 present against a confirmed non-DM/AVS context with Element 29 omitted. The activation and omission rules remain under review.

testCases.assertion: In an authorized Direct Marketing/AVS request context, Element 29 contains a synthetic invoice number.
In a separately authorized non-Direct-Marketing/AVS context, Element 29 is omitted.

openQuestions: What specific transaction/purchase condition makes a request Direct Marketing/AVS for purposes of Element 29?
Does source or approved policy require omission when that condition is false, or is the C marker broader?
Which independent fixture proves the request context without relying on the Element 29 value itself?
Review and authorize the complete Segment 104 request and expected outcomes before execution.
